description: This file defines a transcription logging observer class `TranscriptionLogObserver` for the Pipecat project. It logs speech-to-text transcription frames and interim results from the STTService to the console for debugging and monitoring purposes.

classes.name: TranscriptionLogObserver
classes.description: An observer class that logs transcription activity to the console by monitoring frames from the speech-to-text service.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method that handles frame push events, logging transcription or interim transcription frames with timestamps and user info, but only if the source is an STTService instance.
